patches.title: Grab Immediately When Seen
patches.principle: If the goal object is visible on the current surface, take it without delay.
patches.when_to_apply: When you arrive at a surface and the target item is listed in the observation.

patches.title: Direct Post-Transform Placement
patches.principle: After transforming the object (cleaning/cooling/heating), go straight to the destination container, open it if needed, then place it.
patches.when_to_apply: After using a transformation tool (sink, fridge, microwave) on the held object.

patches.title: Ordered Open Surface Search
patches.principle: Search open surfaces (countertops, tables, bathtub) in ascending numerical order before opening any containers.
patches.when_to_apply: When the target object is not yet found and open surfaces remain.
